summary:
- Oracle Fusion SCM Functional Consultant with 3+ years of experience delivering end-to-end Oracle Fusion implementations, integrations, and production support.
- Proven expertise across Order Management (OM), Inventory (INV), Procurement (P2P), DOO, Pricing, SSP, Supplier portal, and integrations, with hands on experience in data migration (FDBI, ADFDI), OTBI reporting, UAT leadership, and post go live stabilization.
- Recognized for driving business outcomes, reducing operational issues, accelerating order cycles, and ensuring zero defect deployments through rigorous testing and stakeholder collaboration.
- Detailed knowledge and Hands on experience of Oracle Fusion Supply chain Modules Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Product Management.
- Excellent written, oral, visual and communication skills.
- Extensive experience in creating knowledge documents.
- Productive in both team based and self managed projects.
- Professional at managing priorities, learning new concepts quickly, and building strong relationships with colleagues and clients. Currently seeking roles in Consulting / Implementation role to leverage their expertise and problem solving skills.
